verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style hierarchy: bold sans-serif display headings, restrained mono uppercase micro-labels (section numbers, stat captions, table headers), generous line-height in body copy, and perfect weight contrast between the hero pull-quote and supporting text. No orphans, no cramped lines, tracking is consistent and professional.
verdicts.color: Strict single-accent discipline executed perfectly. One red variable used consistently for the logo mark, hero word ('this'), section numerators, active list indicators, matrix 'CORE' marks, the final column's 2px left rule and header, and analysis grid numbers. Near-black on white provides excellent contrast. No off-brand colors or visual noise anywhere.
verdicts.layout: Excellent overall grid alignment and whitespace rhythm. The only visible anomaly is in d4-analysis: the hairline border between analysis card columns 3 and 4 (the red 'THE RESULT' cell) appears slightly thicker/heavier than the borders between columns 1-2 and 2-3, breaking the strict 1px uniformity of the analysis grid. All other layouts (hero, field, matrix, outlook, verdict, footer) are perfectly aligned with consistent padding and intact hairline borders.
verdicts.components: Publication-grade component quality. The matrix table uses clear legend icons (solid red square, dashed outline, empty), correctly implements a sticky first column with a subtle functional shadow visible in the scrolled state (d9), and properly distinguishes the final 'THIS SYSTEM' column with a 2px red left rule and red header text. The accordion list shows clean affordances (chevrons), the stat strip is well-proportioned, and the footer sits correctly at the document bottom.
verdicts.responsive: Mobile layout at 390px is robust: text wraps cleanly, the matrix table handles horizontal overflow with a sticky first column and clear 'SWIPE TO COMPARE' affordance, and stacking order is logical. Dark mode execution on desktop shows consistent palette usage, high contrast for readability, and correct inversion of UI elements (borders, icons, backgrounds) without losing the Swiss-style grid integrity. No concrete visual defects found in the provided evidence.

layout: In the Analysis grid (d4-analysis), ensure the vertical border between column 3 and column 4 (adjacent to the red 'THE RESULT' cell) renders at the same 1px weight as the other internal column dividers to maintain strict hairline uniformity.
